title: OISA coupling interface — Boolean (MaBoSS Treg) formalism
formalism: continuous-time Boolean (MaBoSS), quasi-steady-state per GSimT tick

timescale_justification.QSS_validity: FOXP3 attractor probability stable from t=30 to t=80 a.u. (0.585 plateau) => relax-to-attractor each tick is valid; Boolean equilibrates within one GSimT tick
timescale_justification.slow_variable_note: Proliferation is an accumulator (0.33->0.61 over t=30->80); read as rate, not attractor

inbound_coupling.description: Antigen/infection signal from ODE(viral) or ABM(infected fraction) drives Boolean environmental inputs.

map.$ActTCR2: clip(infected_fraction, 0.05, 1.0)  # antigen -> TCR activation (continuous rate, native to model)

inbound_coupling.mode: continuous-rate (NOT thresholding) — preserves the model's native continuous istate semantics
inbound_coupling.rationale: Graded $ExtIL2 yields graded FOXP3 attractor probability (0->0.58) with native UQ peaking mid-decision (Bernoulli p(1-p)); thresholding would destroy this.

outbound_coupling.description: Boolean cell-fate outputs feed back as quantitative phenotype fractions.

export_signals.label: FOXP3
export_signals.meaning: fraction of CD4+ T cells committing to regulatory (immunosuppressive) Treg phenotype
export_signals.ci_95: NATIVE from MaBoSS sampling error [p2.5,p97.5] via Bernoulli/Wilson on sample_count

feedback_target.mechanism: Treg suppress effector CTL function: effective killing scaled by (1 - w*treg_fraction)
feedback_target.note: immunosuppression modulates viral clearance — closes ODE<->Boolean loop

native_uq.type: aleatoric (Monte-Carlo sampling error), native to Boolean formalism
native_uq.estimator: ci_95 = [p2.5,p97.5] from Wilson interval on FOXP3 probability at given sample_count
native_uq.contrast: ODE/ABM ci_95 are post-hoc ensemble/bounds; Boolean ci_95 is intrinsic to one run
native_uq.bernoulli_shape: error maximal at p=0.5 (ambiguous decision), minimal at p in {0,1}

scheduling.boolean_tick: every GSimT tick (6 h): accept antigen signal -> relax to attractor -> emit treg_fraction
scheduling.causal_order: ODE/ABM emit antigen (tick N) -> Boolean accepts, relaxes, emits treg_fraction (tick N) -> ODE accepts suppression (tick N+1, one-tick lag) — same pattern as existing ABM<->ODE loop
scheduling.transfer_lag_s: optional; Treg suppression onset lag can be encoded via export_signals[].transfer_lag_s (reuses SignalQueue primitive)
